changelog.title: CLH Path Action Modal
changelog.description: Clicking the Command Line Hacker learning path now opens a 3-option modal: Browse Modules, Course Home, or Dismiss.

changelog.title: CLH Course Home Page
changelog.description: New dedicated landing page for the Command Line Hacker course with all 31 modules across 7 tiers, progress tracking, and direct lab access.

changelog.title: CLH Search Discoverability
changelog.description: All 31 CLH modules are now fully searchable by 'CLH', 'Command Line Hacker', 'terminal', 'cli', and topic-specific keywords.

changelog.title: CLH Registry Complete
changelog.description: All 31 CLH modules registered with slides, labs, and quizzes. Fixed self-referential prerequisites that blocked module navigation.
